sources.author: Pixel Camera
patch_list: Run Add Me without the EdgeTPU

Makes Add Me load its CPU models instead of the Tensor EdgeTPU models. Without this, Add Me crashes the app instantly in any renamed or re-signed build, because the EdgeTPU allowlist rejects it and the app aborts instead of falling back. A…
Allows the Pixel Camera thumbnail to open captured media in the system-default gallery instead of requiring Google Photos.
Use third-party gallery on lock screen

Also opens lock screen captures in the system-default gallery. Third-party galleries do not implement Android's secure review contract, so the gallery may show your entire library above the lock screen.

sources.label: Pixel Camera patches for Morphe: Video Boost
sources.author: GCamVBoost
patch_list: Changes the package name (default com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng) so the patched app installs next to the stock Google Camera. Renames provider authorities and custom permissions in the manifest and the matching strings in code.
Updates static launcher shortcuts (Take a selfie, Take a video) in shortcuts.xml so they target the modified package instead of throwing 'App isn't installed'.
Bypasses EdgeTPU JNI native initialization in Magic Capture and falls back to CPU scoring to prevent SIGABRT crashes on non-stock signatures.
Prevents IllegalArgumentException crashes on file_name and restore_path columns when saving Video Boost or querying MediaStore without stock Google Photos signatures.
Adds two launcher shortcuts that open video mode with Video Boost on or off ("Video VB On" and "Video VB Off" by default).
Controls Video Boost when the camera opens: remember the last setting (default), always on, or always off. Video Boost can still be switched on and off as usual.
